questions.prompt: An App Service app has automatic backups and stores business data in an externally mounted Azure file share. What should the recovery design include?

options.text: Separate protection and restore procedures for the mounted share.
options.explanation: Automatic App Service backups exclude custom-mounted Azure storage.

options.text: Assume every mounted share is included in the automatic app backup.
options.explanation: The documented scope does not include that external storage.

options.text: Use an app-setting rename to bring the share into the backup.
options.explanation: Renaming configuration does not change the backup coverage.

options.text: Treat the source-code ZIP as a backup of all business data.
options.explanation: The deployment artifact does not contain independently stored application data.

questions.prompt: Before replacing a production App Service app with a backup, which approach provides useful recovery evidence?

options.text: Restore to a supported separate app or slot and test the app and dependencies.
options.explanation: A recovery test checks usable behavior and configuration beyond backup job status.

options.text: Only check that the backup list contains a timestamp.
options.explanation: A recorded backup does not prove the application can function after restoration.

options.text: Edit the backup ZIP manually to make its timestamp newer.
options.explanation: Altering backup artifacts can invalidate recovery.

options.text: Assume app restoration recreates every identity and network dependency.
options.explanation: Several related configurations and external services need separate recovery.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, you design a new App Service recovery setup with Azure SQL. Which database backup approach follows current Microsoft guidance?

options.text: Use Azure SQL native backup and restore alongside app protection.
options.explanation: Microsoft recommends native database tools, and new linked SQL backup configurations were removed in April 2026.

options.text: Depend on creating a new App Service linked SQL backup configuration.
options.explanation: The documented removal schedule has already removed this option for new configurations.

options.text: Assume automatic App Service backups include the SQL database.
options.explanation: Automatic backups do not include linked databases.

options.text: Use a deployment-slot swap as the only database backup.
options.explanation: A slot swap does not create a recoverable database backup.
